summaryFa: آدمک آبی می‌پرسد مأموریت اصلی‌اش کی آغاز می‌شود؛ دوست سبزش نقشهٔ گنجی نشان می‌دهد که مسیرش به تصویر خودِ آدمک آبی می‌رسد.
storyFa: داستان از قاب راست شروع می‌شود: آدمک آبی منتظر شروع مأموریت اصلی است. در قاب چپ، دوست سبز نقشهٔ گنج را باز کرده و به انتهای مسیرِ نقطه‌چین اشاره می‌کند؛ آنجا به جای صندوق گنج، تصویر همان آدمک آبی قرار دارد. آبی با لبخند متوجه می‌شود این جست‌وجوی خودش همان مأموریت است.
meaningFa: مقصد این جست‌وجو پیدا کردن خود و راه خود است؛ کشف هدف، خودش بخشی از مأموریت زندگی است.
revisionSummaryFa: دوست خاکستری در هر دو قاب سبز شد. دفترِ بازِ قاب چپ به نقشهٔ گنج تبدیل شد و انتهای مسیر نقشه به جای صندوق گنج، خودِ آدمک آبی را نشان می‌دهد. ترکیب‌بندی و دو حباب قبلی حفظ شدند.
fullGenerationPromptEnglish:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a square hand-painted watercolor two-panel comic for an adult Persian visual life-advice book. Read the panels RIGHT TO LEFT, with the question at right and the quietly witty realization at left. Meaning: discovering your own purpose is itself your mission; the treasure to discover is yourself, rather than money or a chest of rewards.

SETTING AND LAYOUT: Two related side-by-side courtyard scenes, thin clean white gutter, no heavy panel borders. Warm pale plaster walls and a few leafy green plants, a quiet blue door, gentle sunshine, pale blue sky. Keep the people, short dialogue and map the focus. The watercolor scene ends in irregular natural brush edges before a generous clean white outer margin. Everything important, including feet and the map, is fully inside the frame.

CHARACTERS: One cool BLUE adult seeker and one fresh GREEN adult friend, identical in size, color, proportions and identity between panels. Blue has a small practical burgundy backpack. Otherwise both have the same simple neutral adult colored body as the established book figures, no ordinary clothing, no sexed anatomy, no hair. Moderate, balanced limbs and torsos, neither chubby/chibi nor extremely thin. Heads are plain true circles, equal width and height, without jaws, chins or flattened lower arcs. Draw a soft shadow in the local body color beneath each head to distinguish the head from the torso. Outlines are darker shades of their own body colors, deep blue for blue and deep green for green, never black outlines around bodies. Simple eyebrows, expressive small mouth, small dark vertical oval eyes with tiny light-reflection glints, absolutely no white sclera or human eyeballs. No need for eyelashes in this scene. Each visible full hand has exactly three fingers plus one thumb, attached naturally to its single arm; exactly two arms and two hands per figure.

RIGHT PANEL, QUESTION: Blue stands on the right, puzzled, looking at green. Blue touches the chin with one hand and holds a small closed brown spiral personal notebook against the chest with the other. The notebook cover is plain, without letters. The friend stands on the left, listening kindly, hands naturally behind the back, not a teacher or official. One white speech bubble with tail to BLUE says exactly in Persian: "مأموریت اصلی‌م کی شروع می‌شه؟" No other text in this panel.

LEFT PANEL, REALIZATION: Same two people: green at left and blue at right. Both look down together at a large single unfolded tan parchment TREASURE MAP held by GREEN. Green supports the lower edge with one hand and points to its destination with the other. Blue leans in slightly with a dawn of recognition, warm small smile and hands gently clasped near the chest. The green pointing fingertip is close to the blue-self destination on the actual paper. The sheet is an unfolded map, NOT a spiral notebook, poster or three pictures. Give it modest irregular parchment edges and sparse painted mountain, tree and river marks. A simple dotted red route winds across the paper and ends at ONE small unmistakable BLUE HUMANOID SYMBOL, matching the seeker: a circular blue head, simple neutral blue torso and limbs, tiny simple smiling face. This is a flat painted pictogram on the paper, not a miniature living person. The route's treasure is the seeker himself; NO chest, gold, gems, trophy, money or other prize. A few small warm radiating strokes emphasize that blue-self destination, without adding text. Keep the map naturally angled toward its TWO READERS: the blue pictogram's head is toward the nearer/lower edge of the paper and its feet toward the farther/upper edge, hence upside-down to the external viewer. Do not turn the map's icon upright to the external viewer at the cost of its correct orientation to the characters. The map must remain large and clear, not crammed with decorative marks. One white speech bubble with its tail correctly attached to GREEN says exactly: "همین پیدا کردن راه خودت!" No caption, labels or other words on the map.

MEDIUM: Luminous but moderate REAL hand-painted watercolor, translucent overlapping wash layers visible inside bodies as well as scenery. Notice textured paper, subtle pigment pooling, soft natural watercolor blooms and varying wash density. Keep soft local-color volume and a few restrained highlights without making plastic or shiny 3D. No marker, colored-pencil hatching, vector flats, dense digital noise or thick black figure contours. Warm, kind, memorable human humor, family friendly, suitable for adult readers and readily understood without an explanatory caption. Only the two specified short Persian speech texts, legible correct right-to-left lettering. No English, watermark, logo, panel numbers, extra panels, added people or props.
editPromptEnglish:
Use case: precise-object-edit, narrative book illustration. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a loose reference. Make a focused edit to this existing square, two-panel right-to-left Persian watercolor comic. Preserve the exact existing composition, two panels and gutter, courtyard, pale warm walls, foliage, expressions, simple neutral adult proportions, genuinely circular head outlines, small dark oval eyes with tiny glints and no white sclera, watercolor washes and local-color outlines, feet and clean irregular white margins. Keep the BLUE protagonist blue, with the same burgundy backpack, and preserve the two short Persian speech bubbles exactly as they are: right panel blue says «مأموریت اصلی‌م کی شروع می‌شه؟»; left panel the friend says «همین پیدا کردن راه خودت!». No new text.

Only the following requested changes: (1) In BOTH panels recolor the entire warm-gray friend a harmonious medium fresh GREEN with layered transparent watercolor and a darker shade of green outlining and soft shading under the circular head. Keep the friend's same face, size, posture and neutral body; no clothes or gendered anatomy. (2) In the LEFT panel replace the open spiral-bound journal held by this friend with ONE unfolded parchment TREASURE MAP, in the same important composition area. Remove the notebook spiral binding and the three diary illustrations completely. The green friend supports the map with one hand and points to its destination with the other, exactly two hands and two arms total. Draw a simple winding dotted treasure-route across the map. AT THE ROUTE'S DESTINATION draw one clear little BLUE humanoid symbol matching the same blue protagonist (round blue head, neutral blue body, tiny burgundy backpack); this blue self is the TREASURE, so there must be NO treasure chest, coins, jewels, gold, trophy or other destination object. This is a painted pictogram flat ON THE PAPER, not a tiny living person outside it. The green fingertip points directly to that blue-self destination. The map lies open facing the two readers, so its blue person pictogram is rotated toward them: its head toward the map's lower/nearer edge and its feet toward the upper/far edge, therefore upside-down to us the external viewer. Keep the map as a coherent single sheet seen with the same natural oblique perspective, not a front-facing poster. It is a plain treasure map rather than a labeled world map: only a dotted route, sparse simple topographic marks and the unmistakable blue-self endpoint. Make it large enough that the viewer notices the blue-self destination immediately. Blue looks down at that destination with the existing dawning smile and gently clasped hands. Keep the blue protagonist's closed personal notebook and all other right-panel objects unchanged. Do not add panels, people, arms, scenery or captions. Hands when fully visible have three fingers plus one thumb. Preserve the original restrained layered hand-painted watercolor style throughout; no redesign into vector, marker, glossy 3D or chibi bodies.

notesFa: خروجی واقعی باز شد: دوست در هر دو قاب سبز است و شخص اصلی آبی با کولهٔ زرشکی ثابت مانده است.
در قاب چپ یک برگ نقشهٔ گنج با مسیر قرمز نقطه‌چین به آدمک آبی ختم می‌شود؛ صندوق یا طلا وجود ندارد.
تصویر آبی روی کاغذ نسبت به بیننده وارونه و رو به خودِ خوانندگان نقشه است.
دو گفت‌وگوی فارسی و ترکیب‌بندی قبلی حفظ شدند؛ سرها گرد، اندام‌ها خنثی و رنگ‌آمیزی لایه‌لایه آبرنگی است.
تولید با یک ویرایش محدود انجام شد؛ بازتولید یا تلاش اضافه لازم نشد.
qa.limitations: Support-hand fingers are partly hidden by the map, so every digit cannot be independently counted. The tiny blue pictogram is simplified and does not show its burgundy backpack; its color, circular head and neutral body match the protagonist. This version still requires the user's final approval.

rootVisualReview.observations: Both friends are green; the held treasure map has a dotted route ending at a blue person rather than a chest. Its symbol faces the readers. Original two panels, speech text and character identities remain. Grip naturally obscures some fingers.
